results.title: G+D Ventures Invests in Impossible Cloud | Sovereign Cloud
highlights:
# G+D Ventures invests in Impossible Cloud, strengthening Europe’s sovereign cloud infrastructure

19.10.2026

G+D Ventures, the venture capital arm of Giesecke+Devrient, invests in Impossible Cloud, a European provider of sovereign cloud and AI infrastructure

G+D Ventures is investing in Impossible Cloud, a European provider of sovereign cloud and AI infrastructure. With this investment, the venture capital arm of Giesecke+Devrient reinforces its conviction that trusted digital infrastructure is essential to Europe’s digital future. Impossible Cloud operates a high-performance, unified cloud platform hosted in certified European data centres, combining cloud storage with AI computing power. This gives businesses access to scalable cloud and AI infrastructure operated entirely in Europe, offering a powerful alternative to non-European hyperscalers.

...

In addition to cloud storage, Impossible Cloud offers GPU-based computing power for AI applications. Bringing cloud storage and AI computing together within a European infrastructure opens up new opportunities for businesses to run data-intensive applications and AI workloads without relying on non-European providers. For G+D Ventures, it is precisely this combination of technological innovation, European sovereignty and growing market demand that makes Impossible Cloud particularly attractive.

...

### About Impossible Cloud

Impossible Cloud is a European cloud infrastructure company that helps enterprises put their data to work with AI while keeping it secure and protected under European law. Headquartered in Hamburg, Germany, Impossible Cloud offers managed inference for open-weight AI models and dedicated NVIDIA GPU servers alongside its sovereign, S3-compatible object storage, all in ISO 27001-certified European data centers. More than 4,000 businesses use Impossible Cloud directly or through IT resellers and managed service providers.
